name: RouterPlus
long_description:
RouterPlus is a marketplace for AI inference. We find the right AI model for a team's product, then get it served at the team's scale, at the best price.

Most teams that run AI in production pay for a top model on every task, when a cheaper model can do most of the work. The same model can also cost twice as much depending on which provider runs it, and many providers fail at peak traffic.

RouterPlus tests models on a team's own traffic and recommends one. Providers then compete for the workload. We check that the chosen provider can hold the team's real peak, and we keep a second provider ready as a backup. Teams call the model through one API.

Our largest customer runs 3 million agent conversations a day on RouterPlus.
one_liner: Marketplace for AI inference: the right model at the best price

launches.title: RouterPlus: Better inference pricing, latency and capacity for AI teams
launches.tagline: The marketplace for your inference needs
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** RouterPlus finds the cheapest AI model that works on your own traffic, then has inference providers compete to serve it. You get inference sourced at the best price and capacity sized for your peak traffic, all in one API

**If inference cost, performance or capacity is holding you back, [book a call](https://cal.com/team/routerplus/platform-demo) or email us at [founders@routerplus.com](mailto:founders@routerplus.com)**

\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PTKXCIPFLrU&feature=youtu.be>

**The problem:** Teams running AI in production often pay for a frontier model on every task when a cheaper model can do most of the work. The same model costs widely different and exhibits different behavior through different providers

**What we do:** RouterPlus is a managed inference marketplace. We test models on your own traffic and find the best one for your workload. Then providers compete for your workload. We check that the provider can handle your real peak, keep a backup provider ready, and give you one API to call. Think Costco for inference: we pool demand so providers compete for bigger deals and teams get better terms.

**In practice:**

* A consumer app with \~3M messages/day switched from a closed model to an open one through us and got 25% lower P95 latency, lower cost and better quality.
* A fast-growing AI assistant company came to us after two outages in one week. We sourced capacity for peaks of 15× their average and set up a backup provider.
* We pooled demand from several teams into one deal. The provider filled its GPUs and each team got better terms.
